## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `go test -race ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (if users notice the change)
- [ ] `README.md` updated (if the API, config or deployment changed)
